# Environment light (look=next)

`kloofendal_overcast_puresky_1k.hdr`: **Kloofendal Overcast (Pure Sky)** by Greg Zaal, Poly Haven,
https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_overcast_puresky, the 1k Radiance HDR file.

Licence: **CC0 1.0 Universal** (public domain; https://polyhaven.com/license,
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). No attribution is required; it is given here anyway.

Used only behind `?look=next` (components/world/look.ts): loaded once, prefiltered to a PMREM by
three.js and used for image-based light and reflections (`scene.environment`), never drawn as the
sky. Downloaded 2026-11-09.
